name: Verigate Authority
tagline: AI agents propose payments. Verigate gates the wallet hand-off.
description: Describe a payment in plain language. The bundled Verigate Python Executa calls Anna's host LLM through protocol-v2 reverse Sampling to extract exact payment details, resolve ambiguity and flag recipient/purpose mismatches, urgency and prompt-injection attempts. AI is advisory only: Verigate's deterministic policy engine owns ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK and AI findings can only escalate ALLOW to WARN. Missing details stop before policy evaluation. For ALLOW, the user explicitly confirms the exact payment in the App to issue a one-time signed Execution Authorization. A separate confirmation is required before wallet submission; each step is gated by a 60-second App-scoped, one-time approval that direct chat/tool calls cannot create. For native USDC on Base and Ethereum, Verigate ExecutionRouter verifies and consumes the signed permission before the connected EIP-1193 wallet is asked to sign and submit the exact transfer. Wallet private keys stay in the wallet. Anna does not hold keys. Solana remains policy/authorization-only in this release. WARN and BLOCK never receive execution authority. Decision Receipts and permissions are verified with Ed25519.
